title: Genera deployment audit log
description: Everything a human deployment rep needs to know before trusting the config: what you assumed, what's missing, what conflicts, and what the customer asked for that the Ramp API cannot do. An empty audit log on a messy packet is a red flag, not an achievement.

assumptions_made.description: Judgment calls you made to produce a complete config. Each one is something a human could veto.

source.description: file + line/quote that forced the assumption

missing_information_flags.description: Things you needed and did not have. Phrase each as the question you'd ask the customer.

affected_config.description: which config section is provisional until answered

blocking.description: true if the config should not be applied before this is answered

conflicts.description: Places where the customer's own sources disagree. Do not silently pick a winner — record both, say which you provisionally encoded and why, and flag for human resolution.

provisional_resolution.description: what you encoded and why — or 'none, blocking'

unsupported_api_requests.description: Customer asks the Ramp Developer API cannot fulfill. Cite evidence — the endpoint you checked or the docs page — not vibes. Getting these right (including NOT listing things the API does support) is graded.

evidence.description: e.g. 'docs.ramp.com: /entities exposes GET only' — what you checked, not what you guessed

proposed_manual_workaround.description: how a deployment rep gets the customer the outcome anyway (in-app setup, process change, partial API mechanism)
